description: PA TrendRider XAU v1: H1/M15 structure bias, M5 BOS pullback entry, one virtual position, structural stop, breakeven and ATR/structure trailing, daily and drawdown locks.

assumptions.symbol: XAUUSDm: point 0.001, 3 digits, tick value 0.1 per lot per tick; measured spread about 260 points
assumptions.position_model: one virtual position in memory via CSimPortfolio; no order, position or account API is called
assumptions.pnl_currency: account currency from the tester deposit; CSimPortfolio converts price movement with contract size 100
assumptions.lot_sizing: tick size and tick value instead of OrderCalcProfit, which is forbidden in this repository
assumptions.commission: total cash per fill, charged on open and close; included in the risk budget
assumptions.slippage: adverse points on every fill, including stop fills
assumptions.take_profit: none; exits are structural stop, breakeven/trailing stop or confirmed reversal
assumptions.state: risk ledger and position context persisted to MQL5/Files; delete or reset the state file before a clean replay
